Glance 2026.08.15 expands image preview and metadata support while refining settings and updates.

## Highlights

- Preview HEIC, AVIF, and camera RAW files through new optional components.
- Preview files directly from MTP devices and other non-filesystem Shell sources.
- Inspect grouped EXIF details for built-in and component-provided image formats, with an optional capture-time footer field.
- Restrict gallery navigation to files with the same extension when preferred.
- Use the cleaner Add-ons and Maintenance pages, including direct WebView2 guidance when its runtime is unavailable.
- Start update installation from the default highlighted action and follow shorter ffprobe download prompts.
